steps.text: 4:12 P.M. \ Clear
Central Kazimierz, Kawalerielki Alliance, 'The Grand Knight Territory' Kawalerielki
At the scene of a certain unsightly car accident

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Oh... We still gonna make it to tonight's party?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It'll be your fault if we don't, V.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: My fault? Hah! My damned fault?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It's you and that goddamned box of yours, all thirty kilos of it! You think you aren't heavy enough, huh?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: These are tools for fixing Marcin's stuff! That's your excuse for crashing into a tree?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Do not question my sense of direction!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I'm saying that your vision ain't as good as it used to be...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Did you forget how I won that darts competition at the bar last week? My eyesight's great as ever! You must be blind.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I'm not blind, which is why I clearly told you earlier 'watch out for that tree.'

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Why don't I remember that?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Because the radio was too loud!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Well, who put Monster Siren's new disc in?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...Just shut up and let the lass focus.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wow... This car is totally wrecked...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It's all V's fault.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I... You... Maria, don't listen to his bullshit. This is absolutely not my fault!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Alright, alright! Just let me work, sheesh——!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hear that? You're disturbing the young lass, just keep quiet.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Circuit's OK, but the engine is unresponsive. Hmm, this design is something from two generations ago? Do you start it like this...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Still no response from the engine. What if I use some Arts to start it...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Like so?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Mhmm, seeing the young lass use Arts like this always reminds me of her grandfather.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's right! Just look at Maria! Why don't you know even a lick of Originium Arts?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Who says I don't know how to repair Originium devices?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I'm talking about——

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Maria! Move aside! I'm going to make this old geezer eat his words!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha...please don't argue, you two...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh! There's a reaction!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Like this... and that...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Oho! The engine's alive? This blessed sound of a rumbling engine!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Little Maria's really getting better day by day. I suppose it's just about time for a certain old fogey to retire too, eh?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hehe, it's nothing like that. It's all thanks to Master Kowal's teachings.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hear that? Hear that? Did——you——hear——that?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Tch. Stop blathering and get in the car.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Lass, where are you headed to? Want us to give you a ride?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I have other business.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Alright then. Hold on tight, Kowal. I must have the first pick of the wine tonight!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Of course——Wait, doesn't the engine sound weird——

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Off we go!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Why are you driving so fast?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I'd've gone even faster in my youth, you know! Also, I haven't hit the accelerator yet!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Huh? Wait, we're at 70mph now, slow——slow down! Hey, it's 80mph now! We're over the speed limit! We're over it!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Can't slow down! Told you, I'm not accelerating!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Then——! Slam the damned brakes!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... Ahaha... Looks like the Originium engine got overloaded...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I messed up again, ehe.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome, one and all!——Here in Kazimierz, you can enjoy unique dishes and enchanting sceneries, giving you a taste of the distinctive local culture——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But who cares about all that! Here and now, the only thing anyone cares about is the Kazimierz Major!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I am Mob, Greatmouth Mob! And I'm honored to be commentating on today's match!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Within this Roar Arena in the Kawalerielki Central Division, the knights' glory will be put upon display once more!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Today's match is fully sponsored by the Roar Guards Company, as usual. The top ten competitors in the daily points rankings will each receive one limited edition weapon 'Rioter' provided by the Roar Guards!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: That fancy toy will be impossible to sell... *sigh*, I'll be damned if I can find a buyer.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Nevermind, it's from my paymaster after all... hmm?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Competition knights hailing from Kazimierz——no, from all over Terra! The corporations from the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce will all be paying close attention to today's independent knight competitions!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Will you take the lead in the sprint races, or hit the bullseye in the shooting competition? No matter what you compete in, you will all have a chance to gain the favor of the directors!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Of course! There's also the highly anticipated one on one mixed sports! The one with the highest points, the greatest exposure! Any match in this category could get the attention of a Knightclub and catapult you to success!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Want to join the Kazimierz Major? Want to stand atop the glorious knights? Right now, the tickets are in the hands of the participating knights!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Defeat your opponents, earn endless glory and rejoice!
Phew...
Deep breaths, deep breaths...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Without further ado, let's begin the first match of the day——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wait... wait! This participant... She's not just any old farmgirl!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's right! I'm saying that the first match today will be the hottest news on the Kazimierz sports pages for weeks to come!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The reason? This competitor joining us for the first time has a very special 'name'! She may look like a cute girl, but she comes from a very famous family!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: If you know your competition knights——No, just about any loyal customer of Kazimierz would know this name!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Can you get to the point! Show us the new girl already!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hey, let me see the match card for the day.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, Sir Szewczyk.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: These are all familiar faces, hmm... Wait, this last one at the bottom?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes... The preliminaries have been going on for half a month, but it's unusual to see independent knights who've just begun accumulating points, so we...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: This surname——It's the Radiant Knight's——?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Without further ado, let us welcome the first participant of today's matches——

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ——Maria Nearl!
